record.label: Attribution of cost reductions to teams, the wiki, and conferences
record.statement: After the wiki and conferences were both active, the authors attributed an average of 61% of the logarithmic spacetime cost reduction to ideas from the same team, 15% to wiki entries or Lean files from other teams, and 24% to conferences. The average is over three scientific applications.
record.boundary: The Lean proofs establish resource bounds for the circuits. The authors classified where each idea originated, and one improvement can combine ideas from several sources.
